description_en: Retrieves Cloud Connect Network (CCN) instances in a specified region
description_zh: 调用DescribeCloudConnectNetworks接口查询指定地域下已创建的云连接网实例信息
kebab_example: aliyun smartag describe-cloud-connect-networks --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --name ccnname --ccn-id ccn-l9340rlu5enst00000 --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --tag Value=test Key=test --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCloudConnectNetworks

parameters.description_en: The ID of the region where the CCN is located.
parameters.description_zh: 云连接网实例所属地域ID。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the CCN is located
parameters.help_zh: 云连接网实例所属地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.description_en:
The name of the CCN.

The name must be 2 to 100 characters long, start with a letter or a Chinese character, and can contain digits, underscores (\_), periods (.), and hyphens (-).
parameters.description_zh:
云连接网实例名称。

名称长度为2~100个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）和短划线（-）。
